public.line: S-Bahn S1 or S8 (MVV, S-Bahn Muenchen)
public.from: Munich Airport Center S-Bahn station (between Terminals 1 and 2)
public.fareText: EUR 15.10 adult single ticket (Einzelfahrkarte), zones M-5, valid 5 h, from the MVV 2026 price list (valid since 1 Jan 2026; MVV says to use a zones M-5 ticket for city-airport trips). The Airport-City-Day-Ticket (EUR 17.50 single, EUR 32.60 for 2-5 people) is an alternative. Checked 2026-10-12.
public.frequency: S1 and S8 together about every 10 min

alternatives.line: Airport-City-Day-Ticket (MVV), unlimited S-Bahn/U-Bahn/tram/bus trips between airport and city on the day
alternatives.fareText: EUR 17.50 Single ticket; EUR 32.60 Group ticket for 2-5 people (cheaper per person than single tickets from 3 people). Zones M-5, valid until 06:00 the next day.

public.line: S-Bahn S5 or S5X (S-Bahn Mitteldeutschland, MDV tariff)
public.fareText: EUR 6.90 adult single (MDV Einzelfahrkarte, 3 tariff zones, valid 2 h). MDV list valid from Aug 2026: 1 zone Leipzig EUR 3.80, 2 zones EUR 5.00, 3 zones EUR 6.90. The 3-zone count (110, 162, 163) comes from a University of Leipzig travel page, not an MDV zone list; if the airport counted as 2 zones the fare would be EUR 5.00. Ride time 12 min is from the S-Bahn Mitteldeutschland airport page. Checked 2026-10-12.

public.line: Luton DART shuttle + Thameslink train, Luton Airport to London St Pancras (one through ticket)
public.from: Luton Airport terminal, Luton DART station

public.line: S11 S-Bahn (Duesseldorf Flughafen Terminal to Koeln Hbf) with an EinzelTicket NRW; regional trains via Duesseldorf Hbf are also valid on this ticket
public.from: Duesseldorf Flughafen Terminal S-Bahn station, below the terminal
public.fareText: EUR 25.80 EinzelTicket NRW (adult, flat fare for one trip anywhere in NRW, valid 7 h on S-Bahn, RB and RE, not ICE/IC) per VRR and the NRW tariff brochure. Since the June 2026 tariff reform Duesseldorf (VRR) to Koeln (Rheinlandtarif) is a cross-tariff trip and I found no cheaper fixed single. The app tariff eezy.nrw is cheaper (see alternatives). Ride time is the earlier pass's timetable range 81-92 min, not re-checked. Checked 2026-10-12.
public.frequency: about every 20 min per a travel guide (not confirmed)

alternatives.line: eezy.nrw app tariff (check in/out in a eezy-capable app such as mobil.nrw), same trains
alternatives.fareText: Official formula: EUR 1.73 base price + EUR 0.29 per straight-line km, capped at the EinzelTicket price (EUR 25.80). For roughly 41 km between the airport and Koeln Hbf that is about EUR 13.6 (my calculation, not an official quote). Needs smartphone, app account and payment method.

Tickets online, at ticket offices, or from the driver for cash euros if seats are free. Ride time about 1 h 15 min per the Kaunas Airport website (read via search summary). Checked 2026-10-12.

public.line: ZET bus 290 (Kvaternik Square - Zagreb Airport - Velika Gorica)
public.from: Zagreb Airport bus stop, outside the terminal
public.to: Kvaternik Square (Kvaternikov trg), not the railway station
public.fareText: EUR 2.65 ZET single for zones I and II (valid 180 min), from the ZET outlying-areas price list. ZET puts Velika Gorica in zone II but its page does not name the airport stop's zone, so zones I+II is an assumption. ZET also lists a EUR 1.99 90-min single sold by the driver (zone not stated). Ride 45-50 min per the airport. Checked 2026-10-12.
public.hours: 04:20-00:27 (no service before 04:20 or after 00:27; Sundays first run 05:20)

alternatives.fareText: Fare not found: plesoprijevoz.hr home page shows a shuttle every 30 min but no price, and the airport page lists no fares. Ride 35-40 min per the airport page.

public.line: Airport shuttle bus A1 (formerly line 91) to Marseille Saint-Charles, La Metropole Mobilite
public.from: Marseille Provence Airport, stop MP1 between halls 3-4 and 1
public.to: Marseille Saint-Charles bus station (gare routiere, rue Honnorat side), next to the train station
public.fareText: EUR 15.00 adult single (Marseille tourist office page 'Tarifs 2026', updated 9 Jul 2026). The airport page sends you to La Metropole Mobilite for rates, and that site returned 403, so the operator list was not read. Return EUR 26.00; ages 12-25 EUR 7.00 (applies to a 23-year-old, bring ID); ages 6-11 EUR 5.00. Ride 30-50 min depending on traffic. Checked 2026-10-12.
public.frequency: every 10 min 07:00-20:00, every 20 min at other times (airport page)
public.hours: from the airport first departure about 04:05-04:10; last about 01:50 per the airport page, which marks the late service 'May to October only', so the winter last departure is not confirmed

alternatives.line: Airport shuttle bus A1, youth fare (12-25 years)
